Toronto PPC Frequently Asked Questions
How Much Does PPC Management Cost in Toronto?
PPC investment in Toronto involves two distinct costs: the management fee paid to the agency and the ad spend paid directly to Google

Management fees vary based on campaign complexity, number of channels, and scope — NexFortis scopes fees transparently following a free audit, with no fabricated flat-rate pricing published out of context
Ad spend budgets are recommended based on your industry's Toronto CPC landscape, competitive density, and business goals discussed during the audit
How Soon Will I See Results from Google Ads in Toronto?
Google Search Ads can generate clicks and enquiries within hours of a campaign going live — paid search delivers immediate visibility that SEO cannot match in the short term
Meaningful optimisation data typically accumulates within the first 30–60 days, allowing bid strategies and targeting to be refined for the Toronto market
Campaigns continue to improve as conversion data, Quality Scores, and audience signals build over time
Do I Own My Google Ads Account?
Yes — NexFortis operates on a strict account-ownership policy; your Google Ads account is created in your name or transferred to your ownership from day one
All campaign data, keyword lists, ad copy, and conversion history remain yours regardless of the agency relationship
Google Ads vs SEO for Toronto Businesses — Which Should I Choose?
Google Ads delivers immediate, controllable visibility for high-intent Toronto searches; SEO builds long-term organic authority but takes months to generate meaningful traffic
For Toronto businesses needing leads or sales now — particularly in competitive local verticals — PPC is the faster, more predictable channel
The strongest Toronto digital marketing strategies combine both: PPC captures immediate demand while SEO compounds value over time
